# OpenSkiStats

Statistics on downhill ski slopes and ski areas worldwide, derived from OpenSkiMap and OpenStreetMap data.
The distinctive analysis is the compass orientation (aspect) of ski runs, summarized per ski area as orientation roses.

## Pages

- [Home](https://openskistats.org/): project overview.
- [Manuscript](https://openskistats.org/manuscript/): methods, definitions, and the circular statistics behind the metrics.
- [Ski Areas](https://openskistats.org/ski-areas/): interactive table, one row per ski area, with orientation roses.
- [Lifts](https://openskistats.org/lifts/): interactive table, one row per named lift.
- [Story](https://openskistats.org/story/): "Which way do you ski?", a narrative introduction to run orientation.

The ski-area and lift pages build their tables in the browser from the JSON endpoints below.
The HTML carries no rows, so read the JSON rather than scraping the pages.

## Data

- [ski-areas.json](https://openskistats.org/data/ski-areas.json): ~5,950 named ski areas, 32 fields, ~7 MB.
  Records sit under `ski_areas`.
- [lifts.json](https://openskistats.org/data/lifts.json): ~23,974 named lifts, 28 fields, ~24 MB.
  Records sit under `lifts`.
  A lift may serve several ski areas, so `ski_area_ids` and `ski_area_names` are arrays.

Both endpoints share an envelope: `schema_version`, `data_updated_at`, `license`, `attribution`, `sources` (upstream URL, timestamps, and SHA-256 per source), `record_count`, `record_schema`, and the records array.
`record_schema` is a JSON Schema whose `properties` carry a prose description of every field, the authoritative reference for what a column means.

The files are large.
Fetch and parse them with code, and do not read one into a model context whole.

## Source and terms

- [Source code](https://github.com/dhimmel/openskistats): the `openskistats` Python package that produces these datasets, released under a BSD-2-Clause Plus Patent License.
- [OpenSkiMap](https://openskimap.org/) and [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/): upstream data, from which every record derives.
- Data is released under [ODbL-1.0](https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/), inherited from OpenStreetMap, and requires attribution and share-alike.
  Website prose is [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
- Attribute as: OpenSkiStats; source data from OpenSkiMap and OpenStreetMap contributors.
